ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Driver/DLL Installation Via Odbcconf.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "odbcconf" with the "INSTALLDRIVER" action where the driver doesn't contain a ".dll" extension. This is often used as a defense evasion method.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\odbcconf\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "odbcconf\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*INSTALLDRIVER\\ .*")) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dll.*"))
